title: Energy use and the sustainability report

cues.text: Follow electricity and water by meter, see what tenants use, and prepare the yearly sustainability report.
Energy shows the mall's electricity and water, from the building meters or imported readings.
The mall's electricity this month and its cost, the peak demand, the night baseload and the carbon it means.
The last 12 months, so the summer peak is easy to see.
By meter splits it up: chillers, lighting, the car park and more.
Landlord and tenants separates what the mall uses from what is charged on to the tenants.
The sustainability tab turns the same figures into the yearly report.
Carbon emissions are worked out for you from the electricity, diesel and gas used.
Figures without a meter, such as diesel, waste and recycling, are recorded here once a month.
Print the report for the owners, or for a green building certificate.
And Meters and import is where meters are added and readings brought in from a file.
